description:
26" Tandem Electric Bike with 500W Motor, Shimano 7-Speed & Disc Brakes
Tandem bikes become all the more fun when you have a friend or two to pedal along. The 500W motor powered tourer is the ultimate performer and has been built to undertake tough challenges of the road. Planning to explore the city during the daytime or at night with the LED headlights, you will surely get a clear vision of the road.
Performance Evaluation: Installation of a performance LCD helps with performance evaluation as it can access vital information like time, speed, riding mode, and distance.
Immediate Acceleration: The throttle mode is the bike’s ultimate power source as it provides instant acceleration. It can also help maintain a constant bike speed while you sit relaxed.
High-Stopping Power: The front and the rear disc brakes offer an immense stopping power with very less hand strength, saving your muscle from fatigue.
Mountain Bike Tires: Take on an incline with your riding partner with the ultra-durable, puncture-proof, 26"x 2.35 mountain tires.
Get ready to head on to an exciting ride on the 26’’ Tandem hi-steel electric bike, which can withstand shocks and take you smoothly through the challenging terrain. The bike uses immensely powerful disc brakes, which give you complete control of the bike.
Shimano 7 speed shifters deliver smooth shifting performance and give multiple speed options to travel through multiple terrains. The electric bike weighs 60 lbs and is available in red and black colors. The Micargi alloy handlebar gives a great grip no matter where you are riding.
The dual front and rear disc brakes offer high-stopping power and ensure that the bike stops immediately at a moment's notice. Disc brakes require very little maintenance and offer high-durability, so you do not have to get the brakes replaced.
The bike is equipped with 26’’ X 2.35 MTB tires, which have a full knobby tread pattern that ensures high traction. On dry or wet roads, the mountain bike tires provide a great grip on either of the roads.
Samsung lithium-ion 48V 10.4Ah battery is compact sized and does not take much space on the bike. It can be easily removed to charge. The lithium batteries are environment-friendly and perform great. The battery can be recharged multiple times.
Tandem bikes offer twice the fun as you take your partner along for those relaxing rides where you can chit chat and give your muscles a bit of an exercise.
The bike’s performance can be evaluated with the LCD installed at the bike’s front. You can keep track of the performance statistics like time, distance, riding mode and speed.
